gre.detail: CS department does not require GRE and is prohibited from reviewing GRE scores for any applicants; do not upload GRE scores.

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of UCSB CS graduate admissions materials.

toefl.detail: CS department minimum TOEFL iBT total 5.0 (new scale, exams on/after 2026-01-21) or 100 (exams before 2026-01-21); higher than UCSB university minimum 4.0/80. Institution code 4835.

ielts.detail: IELTS Overall Band 7 (department/Grad Division CS listing).

english.waiver: Exempt if completed undergraduate or graduate degree at an institution where verified sole official language of instruction is English (U.S. regionally accredited or WHED sole-English listing). DET also accepted: CS department minimum 130 (university minimum 120).

gpa.detail: Minimum 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA; non-4.0 scales re-calculated in context during review. Bachelor's in science, engineering, or mathematics required by department.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters of recommendation submitted online via Grad Division application.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Statement of Purpose (academic/research background and interests) plus separate Personal History Statement (minimum 250 words, narrative form, no duplication of SoP).
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Statement of Purpose; Personal History Statement

resume.detail: Resume or CV submitted in online application (Grad Division CS checklist).

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts from all post-secondary institutions uploaded online; official/final required after SIR if admitted.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CS How to Apply or Grad Division CS requirements pages.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee waiver request available via Grad Division for eligible applicants after Academic Program and Citizenship pages; see Requesting an Application Fee Waiver.
applicationFee.detail: $135 U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $155 all other applicants. Non-refundable.

other: Fall-only admissions (deadline listed on Grad Division CS directory; Dec 15 cycle commonly posted—confirm live directory for Fall 2027).
Duolingo English Test accepted (CS minimum 130).
External MS open; Five-Year MS is current UCSB undergraduates only.
PhD Application Support Program is PhD-focused; MS uses standard Grad Division portal.
applicationRequirements.advice: Prefer Grad Division CS department directory + CS How to Apply over degree-requirements-only masters page. GRE uploads will not be reviewed.
sources: UCSB Grad Division Computer Science program requirements
UCSB Grad Division How to Complete Online Application (fee/English)
UCSB CS Master's Degree (curriculum; not admissions checklist)

items.program: MS in Computer Science and Engineering

gre.detail: GRE not required for PhD and MS applications for Fall 2027; applicants may still submit valid scores (ETS code 4836).

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of CSE graduate admissions materials.

toefl.detail: GEPA university-wide minimum TOEFL iBT 85 (prior scale) or 4.5 (new iBT scale). CSE checklist points to GEPA English page; code 4836. Required for international applicants unless WHED/U.S. exemption.

ielts.detail: GEPA university-wide minimum IELTS Academic Band Score 7.

english.waiver: Exempt if earned/will earn bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree with grades of B (3.0) or better from a regionally accredited U.S. institution where English is sole language of instruction, or a foreign institution listing English as sole language of instruction on IAU WHED. DET (min 120) and PTE Academic (min 65) also accepted per GEPA.

gpa.detail: At least a B average (3.0 GPA) or equivalent required for admission; bachelor's or equivalent from accredited/recognized institution.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters required (additional allowed); typically academic/research advisors; professional/industry referees also acceptable.

statementOfPurpose.detail: SoP submitted online; no specific word limit—address CS/CE accomplishments, qualifications, and graduate goals. Updates after submission not granted.

resume.detail: Resume/CV upload required under Resume/CV section; post-submission updates not granted.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts uploaded for review; official transcripts to Graduate Division if offered admission.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CSE Admissions or Application Checklist pages.

applicationFee.waivers: GEPA need-based waivers for U.S. citizens/PRs/undocumented; international applicants not eligible for GEPA waiver. CSE offers limited fee waivers for international PhD applicants only (not MS)—request by Dec 2, 2026 3pm PST for Fall 2027 cycle.
applicationFee.detail: $135 U.S. citizens/PRs/undocumented; $155 international. Fall 2027 application window Sep 2–Dec 16, 2026 11:59pm PST.

other: Fall quarter only; MS and PhD mutually exclusive (apply to one).
BS preferred in CS/CE/EE/math but not required if minimum CSE background completed.
Duplication of advanced degrees normally not permitted.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use CSE Admissions + Application Checklist for Fall 2027; do not rely on MS curriculum page alone. Optional ≠ waived for GRE.

gre.detail: Official GRE optional for MS; choosing not to submit will not harm chances. ETS code 3917. UMass graduates exempt from GRE requirement.

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of CICS MS admissions materials.

toefl.detail: Graduate School minimum: TOEFL combined 80 (tests before Jan 2026) or 4.0 (tests Jan 2026 or later). CICS how-to-apply defers to Grad School International Applicants page. Code 3917.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic minimum combined 6.5 (Graduate School). DET 115 and PTE Academic 53 also accepted.

english.waiver: May be waived for citizenship in listed English-speaking countries; bachelor's/master's from U.S. or listed countries; certain American University campuses; or currently enrolled full-time completing two academic years of U.S. college coursework before entrance (see Grad School International Applicants).

gpa.detail: Graduate School minimum undergraduate GPA 2.75/4.00; programs may expect higher. CICS emphasizes strong CS undergraduate preparation (listed core CS/math courses).

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Two letters; choose writers who can speak to research, community service, or work experience. Requested via Grad School application after submit.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal statement; suggestions include research/industry experience, computing for common good, and diversity/STEM impact. Grad School also requires a Short Essay (≤600 words) on community/group contribution.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial for application review; official required by Graduate School if admitted. Missing transcripts block evaluation.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CICS on-campus MS How to Apply page.

applicationFee.waivers: Current Five College undergraduates applying to master's-only programs do not pay admission fee; other Grad School waiver categories (McNair, GRE fee reduction, etc.).
applicationFee.detail: Nonrefundable $90 application fee payable online by credit card (UMass Graduate School).

other: Target on-campus MS (not online MS) for this catalog id.
Terminal MS students ineligible for campus assistantships (Fall 2016+ cohort rule); grader/hourly roles possible after first semester.
Undergraduate preparation checklist of CICS/MATH core courses strongly expected.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use CICS How to Apply — MS Program (on Campus); degree-requirements page alone lacks admissions checklist.
sources: CICS How to Apply — MS Program (on Campus)
UMass Graduate School How to Apply (fee)

gre.detail: GRE not required but recommended; no penalty for omitting scores; no minimum GRE score. Holistic review.

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of UNC CS graduate admissions materials.

toefl.detail: Graduate School recommended minimum TOEFL iBT 90 (tests before 2026-01-26) or 5 (tests on/after 2026-01-26). Code 5816. Required for international applicants unless exemption. CS FAQ: no score automatically disqualifies review.

ielts.detail: Graduate School recommended minimum IELTS 7; Duolingo English Test also accepted (recommended minimum 110).

english.waiver: Exemptions for applicants from sole-official-English countries (listed); degree from accredited U.S. university; or degree from university where English is sole language of instruction with official verification (see Grad School Instructions).

gpa.detail: Graduate School minimum: bachelor's (four-year or equivalent) and average grade of B (cumulative GPA 3.0) or better.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three current letters via Grad School application (email addresses of recommenders required).

statementOfPurpose.detail: 1–2 pages: objectives; CS fields of interest; relevant qualifications not elsewhere; titles for vague transcript courses; list of courses taken/planned not yet on transcript.

resume.detail: Resume/CV with degrees, work/volunteer, research, publications, awards; optional international standardized tests (e.g., GATE) may be listed.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts from each university attended uploaded in application; official only if admitted.

interview.detail: CS admissions pages do not list a required interview; Grad School notes some programs may require on-site pre-admission interview—CS MS not specified.

applicationFee.waivers: Grad School fee waiver categories available; request within online application with documentation.
applicationFee.detail: Non-refundable $95.00 per program. Fall-only CS entry. Deadlines for Fall 2027 cycle posted: fellowship consideration Dec 15, 2026; RA/TA Jan 5, 2027; final Mar 9, 2027.

other: Cannot apply for both MS and PhD in same semester.
Select up to five Areas of Interest and list up to five faculty (or 'Any faculty').
MS program page (cs.unc.edu/graduate/ms/) is degree requirements, not the admissions checklist.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use CS Graduate Admissions + UNC Grad School Instructions; confirm Fall 2027 deadline page for final dates.
sources: UNC CS Admission to Graduate Programs
UNC Graduate School Instructions for Graduate Applicants

gre.detail: GRE not required for 2027 Master's applications to Viterbi (including MSCS). Official pages do not invite optional GRE submission for 2027 MS.

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of Viterbi MSCS admissions materials.

toefl.detail: International applicants must demonstrate English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/etc.). USC does not set university-wide admission score minimums; ISE exam exemption typically at TOEFL iBT ≥90 with ≥20 each section (pre-2026-01-21) or ≥4.5 with ≥4 each section (on/after 2026-01-21) for master's. Code 4852. Scores within 24 months of application submit.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic accepted; ISE exemption typically overall ≥6.5 with ≥6 each band for master's (placement guideline, not a university-wide admission cutoff).

english.waiver: Exempt if USC degree holder/enrolled; bachelor's from U.S. or qualifying Anglophone country (English only official language + language of instruction)—Spring 2027+ policy: entire program need not be Anglophone but degree must be issued by institution in U.S./qualifying Anglophone country (dual-degree exception); completed master's/doctoral from qualifying Anglophone country; or native English speaker from qualifying countries. No waiver for English-taught programs in non-Anglophone countries.

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA stated on Viterbi MSCS program page; bachelor's required or in progress; holistic review. Eligibility coursework listed for non-CS bachelor's.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Letter of Recommendation listed as Optional on Viterbi MSCS Application Requirements.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal Statement required with online application.

transcripts.detail: Registrar-issued transcripts (electronic/scanned) from all colleges/universities; unofficial student-portal transcripts not acceptable for Viterbi. Hard copies after admission if instructed.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on Viterbi MSCS or Ready to Apply pages.

applicationFee.waivers: Not detailed on Ready to Apply page for Viterbi master's; confirm USC Graduate Admission waiver policy if needed.
applicationFee.detail: $120 application fee (Ready to Apply). Fall deadlines: Dec 15 scholarship consideration; Jan 15 final. Spring Oct 15.

other: OPT STEM eligible.
32-unit general MSCS; thesis option adds units.
Also available via DEN@Viterbi online.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use Viterbi Grad Admission MSCS page (not department curriculum page alone). Optional LOR ≠ waived requirement elsewhere.
sources: USC Viterbi MS in Computer Science admissions

items.program: Professional Master's Program (PMP) in Computer Science & Engineering

gre.detail: PMP does not require GRE; no benefit to providing scores—any scores received will not be referenced during reviews.

gmat.detail: GMAT not part of PMP admissions materials.

toefl.detail: Non-native English speakers must prove proficiency. TOEFL ≥92 (on/before 2026-01-20) or ≥4.5 (on/after 2026-01-21). UW ETS code 4854. Or degree with English as language of all instruction per Grad Policy 3.2.

ielts.detail: Academic IELTS ≥7.0 via E-TRF to UW organization ID 365. DET ≥130 also accepted.

english.waiver: Degree for which English was language of all instruction (documentation required except degrees in Policy 3.2.1 countries). Residence-during-enrollment rules apply depending on whether country is English-speaking.

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA stated on PMP Admissions/How to Apply; report cumulative GPA from each school; Scholaro conversion suggested for international GPAs.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Two letters required; optional third. Prefer supervisors/leads familiar with technical work; due by application deadline.

statementOfPurpose.detail: ~one page / ~750 words personal statement: academic/professional backgrounds, areas of interest, how PMP advances professional goals.

resume.detail: Current resume/CV with detailed job tasks and technical skills; no length/format limit.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts for all higher-ed institutions during application; official only after accepting offer.

interview.detail: Complete How to Apply checklist does not include an interview; decisions 3–4 weeks after deadline.

applicationFee.waivers: UW Graduate School fee waivers for some domestic students with financial need; PMP does not offer department-level waivers.
applicationFee.detail: $90 non-refundable UW Graduate School application fee.

other: FLAG: PMP-ONLY route on this catalog id; PMP unable to accept applicants requiring F-1 or J-1 student visas.
Must physically reside in Seattle/Puget Sound at application and for program duration; part-time study eligibility in U.S.
Established professional background in computing required.
Academic background form (hardware/software/theory/applications) required upload.
Three entry quarters: Autumn (Jul 1), Winter (Nov 1; Winter 2027 extended to Nov 2), Spring (Feb 1); no summer.
applicationRequirements.advice: PMP ≠ full-time research MS; no F-1/J-1. Confirm eligibility before applying. Catalog id maps to PMP admissions page as specified.
sources: Allen School PMP How to Apply

items.program: MS in Computer Sciences (Computer Sciences named option / traditional)

gre.detail: GRE not required but may be considered if available (Guide + CS Admissions FAQ).

gmat.detail: Guide Other Test(s) field: n/a for this named option.

toefl.detail: Refer to Grad School Minimum Requirements (UW-1241): TOEFL ≥92 (tests before 2026-01-21) or ≥5.0 (on/after 2026-01-21). Institution code 1846. Conditional ranges with ESLAT exist with program approval.

ielts.detail: IELTS / IELTS Indicator minimum 7.0; Duolingo minimum 125 (Grad School).

english.waiver: Exempt via U.S. bachelor's; U.S. master's/PhD/professional within 5 years of start; equivalent bachelor's abroad with English exclusive language of instruction documented; or ≥2 full-time graded semesters in English-exclusive instruction within 5 years (no ESL classes).

gpa.detail: Grad School minimum: undergraduate GPA 3.00 on last 60 semester hours (or master's with ≥3.00); international applicants must show comparable achievement.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters required (Guide). Prefer academic recommenders; at most one work recommendation suggested if out of school.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Essay form; ~1–1.5 pages sufficient; background in CS and potential for traditional MS/PhD. Must complete supplemental application sections.
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Statement of purpose / reasons for graduate study

transcripts.detail: Most up-to-date unofficial transcripts from all prior higher-ed institutions; international records original language + official English translation. Official if recommended for admission.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on Guide Admissions table or CS Admissions FAQs.

applicationFee.waivers: Department does not offer fee waivers; Grad School fee grants for eligible U.S. citizens/PRs; some program-purchased grants elsewhere.
applicationFee.detail: $75 application fee (up to three programs same term); international applicants pay additional $6 processing fee. Fall only; deadline Dec 15. Spring/summer not admitted for this option.

other: Traditional MS/PhD single applicant pool—do not apply to both MS and PhD separately.
DISTINCT from Professional MS (PMP) named option (separate admissions, Feb 15 deadline).
Minimum background: some programming, data structures, machine organization; year of college calculus-level math.
Contact admissions@cs.wisc.edu for traditional MS/PhD.
applicationRequirements.advice: Guide named option Computer Sciences MS is traditional track; do not conflate with CS PMP. Optional GRE ≠ waived.
sources: UW–Madison Guide: Computer Sciences MS (Computer Sciences option) Admissions

gre.detail: GRE General Test required for Computer Science MS (GSAS standardized testing table, 2026–2027 cycle). PhD: GRE not accepted. Institution code 3987. Program FAQ: no absolute cut-offs; accepted students generally ~90th percentile.

gmat.detail: GMAT not used for Yale CS MS (GMAT only noted for Management PhD at GSAS).

toefl.detail: TOEFL iBT required of most non-native English speakers (or IELTS Academic). No published hard minimum on GSAS testing page; CS MS FAQ states if TOEFL required they generally look for totals well above 100. Code 3987.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic accepted via E-Delivery to Yale GSAS; no hard minimum published on GSAS testing page. IELTS Online / One Skill Retake / General Training not accepted.

english.waiver: Exempt if undergraduate degree from college/university where English is primary language of instruction and studied in residence ≥3 years. No exemption based on advanced degree (MA/MS/PhD) alone.

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA on GSAS CS program page or Engineering MS program page; FAQ says GPA considered with scores, recommendations, personal statement.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters of recommendation via GSAS application (standard for all PhD/Master's applicants).

statementOfPurpose.detail: Statement of academic purpose required (GSAS prompt; typically 500–1000 words per GSAS application guidance). FAQ: research experience not required for this professional MS.
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Statement of academic purpose / personal statement

resume.detail: Resume/CV required for all GSAS PhD/Master's applicants.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts from all prior colleges/universities uploaded with application; official later if needed.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on GSAS application process or Engineering MS program pages.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee waivers for PhD/Master's applicants via special program/status or documented financial hardship; request form deadline Jan 2; U.S. and non-U.S. citizens eligible to request.
applicationFee.detail: US $105 non-refundable for degree-seeking applicants. MS deadline January 2, 11:59pm ET. Fall entry only.

other: Apply via Yale GSAS (not Engineering department portal).
One-year terminal MS most common; selective two-year MS with teaching fellowship + thesis also offered.
Need CS coursework beyond basic programming/data structures (advanced algorithms, systems/architecture); MOOCs not accepted as formal preparation.
No financial aid for one-year MS; two-year has tuition fellowship + small stipend.
applicationRequirements.advice: GRE required for MS only (opposite of PhD). Confirm 2026–2027 GSAS testing table each cycle.
sources: Yale Engineering CS Master of Science Program
Yale GSAS Computer Science program page
Yale GSAS Application Fees & Fee Waivers
